card.name: Words just before "users" or "USAGE"
card.fires_on: Words right before the word "users" or "usage", such as "current" or "recent" in breast cancer risk among users of hormonal contraceptives. Also "IM" in DMPA-IM users and "AND" in INDICATIONS AND USAGE.

modes.label: Qualifier before users
modes.description: Words like current, recent or IM that describe a type of contraceptive user, just before the word users.

modes.label: Heading before USAGE
modes.description: The word AND inside the section heading INDICATIONS AND USAGE.
modes.example: described in the INDICATIONS<< AND>> USAGE section.

card.writes: It suppresses the word "use" and its variants, so it seems to steer the model toward "users" or "usage" forms rather than the plain verb.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "users" or "usage", as in "current or recent users".
